question: mornings
label: I snooze my alarm again and again
you_said: you snooze your alarm again and again

ideas.i024: Put a sticker in the bathroom or kitchen and set your alarm so it only stops when you tap it. You have to get out of bed to switch it off, and once you're up, you're up.

question: mornings
label: I forget if I already took my vitamins or medicine

ideas.i028: Stick a tag on the bottle and tap it when you take one. Your phone keeps the record, so you'll never wonder “did I already take it?” or take a double dose.
ideas.i029: A second tag under the bottle can open the pharmacy's reorder page, so running out never catches you by surprise.

question: mornings

question: mornings
